  "situation": "On 14 April 1999 a convoy of Albanian refugees traveling on the Djakovica‑Prizren road near the villages of Madanaj and Meja was attacked by NATO aircraft. The convoy consisted of cars, tractors and carts carrying women, children and elderly civilians. Casualties were reported at roughly 70‑75 killed and about 100 injured. NATO later acknowledged the attack, stating that its pilots flew at about 15,000 feet and identified the target with the naked eye, believing the vehicles to be military based on their appearance and movement. The review committee later examined the incident, concluding that civilians were not deliberately targeted and that the aircrews did not act with recklessness sufficient for criminal charges.
